GenAiPlugin.description: Create role-owned service tasks, due windows, acknowledgements, missed-task escalation, and execution notes.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Convert recommendations into proposed Action records such as action:create-service-task, action:send-internal-alert, or action:request-partner-followup.
Name owner role aliases, due time, service window, priority, approval requirement, fallback path, and outcome metric.
Do not execute tasks directly from Agentforce. Only propose tasks and route protected actions for approval.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Use this topic for task coordination, owner assignment, service windows, acknowledgement tracking, and missed work escalation.
